label: 3. Hey, I'm thinking about writing a new song.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Hey, I'm thinking about writing a new song.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Throw me some ideas.
An R&B slow jam about love.
A trap song about breaking up.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: A love song, eh?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Not really in my wheelhouse,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: but it could be fun to give a try.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I've never done a song about love.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I don't know, I may get too worked up writing about that.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I can't get too explicit with my song lyrics.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: If you ask me, there's no such thing as a mutual break-up.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: But even a tumultuous break-up has a certain charm to it.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Okay, a beat is coming to my mind.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: It'd be good if I had someone do a feature. Who fits the bill?
Noise.
Aria.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Yeah, Noise could work.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: That way, her fans would listen to my music too.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Huh? Can you imagine how I'd look performing in an opera house?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I better get started while it's still fresh in my mind.
Can't wait to hear what you come up with.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Trust me, it's gonna be worth the wait.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: My music never disappoints.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You may not be entirely worthless after all.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Clear my schedule for the day.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I want to spend every minute focusing on this song.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Once I've got a beat down, you'll be the first to hear it.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Just so you know, I don't accept any criticism.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Because my beats are perfect.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: See you later.
